_comment: Seed rules, defaults and source registry for routing_test.py and as a starting file for a consumer. Example data only: replace the rules and keep the shape. People are left out on purpose.

sources.mail.direct: Mail a colleague sent TO the owner (not CC, not automated), full body
sources.mail.other: Other recent inbound mail (CC, distribution lists, automated notices)
sources.chat.1on1: A chat 1:1, one candidate per chat holding the recent conversation with the owner's replies
sources.chat.mention: A chat group or channel message that tags the owner, with the messages before it
sources.chat.channel_reply: A reply inside a chat channel thread that does not tag the owner
sources.chat.group: A chat group or meeting chat message that does not tag the owner
sources.ext.1on1: An ext chat DM, one candidate per DM holding the recent conversation with the owner's replies
sources.ext.mention: An ext chat group DM or channel message that tags the owner, with the messages before it
sources.ext.channel: A top-level post in an ext chat channel I am in, external shared channels included
sources.ext.channel_reply: A reply inside an ext chat channel thread that does not tag the owner
sources.ext.group: An ext chat group DM message that does not tag the owner
sources.tracker.assigned: An open ticket assigned to the owner in the current sprint (tracker snapshot)
sources.state.escalation: An escalation recorded in the current state file
sources.state.stale: A stale or blocked ticket recorded in the current state file
sources.state.open_item: An open item awaiting the owner's decision in the current state file
sources.doc.gap: A high or medium documentation gap from the daily doc audit

rules.where: The team that owns the retired system
rules.reason: retired-system is not the owner's to handle. Only an item whose key, title or action names retired-system is routed, one that mentions it in passing stays.
Documentation gaps live on the Knowledge page with their own Tackle, Snooze and Ignore.
Documentation gaps live on the Knowledge page.
Documentation audit findings never become Action Center items.
Every direct ask is considered (a forwarded ask that never reached the board once).
A chat 1:1 can hold open asks and the owner's own commitments.
A tag asking the owner to assist, check, decide or approve is an ask.
An ext chat DM can hold open asks and the owner's own commitments, same as a chat 1:1.
An ext chat tag asking the owner to assist, check, decide or approve is an ask, same as a chat mention.
The owner's own tickets are context. The tracker page already tracks them, the analysis raises one only when it needs a decision.
